description: This means dealing in generalities, the pattern, the trend, people in general at any time, and stating a principle where someone else would give an example.
This means being worthy of others' trust, keeping one's word when breaking it would pay: holding to a promise gone costly, telling the truth when shading it would help, and keeping a confidence.
This means meeting life's small absurdities with quiet, low-key amusement: a raised eyebrow, a deadpan aside or a half-smile at one's own bad luck, with nobody made the butt of the joke.
note: 2026-10-09 (Roger, W3 C3): rewritten to the gentle sense and relabelled non-wry; was a one-way pointer at earnest (the earnest / sardonic pair)
